title: The model-switch hook reads a captured PostModelSwitch payload
body:
Source: #1193 (b085196, t-5rbfkxx) built the PostModelSwitch hook test from guessed payload fields (from_model/to_model plus aliases); the research file names no fields and no live capture exists (KRN-12 gap).
Outcome: a real PostModelSwitch payload is captured verbatim under test/fixtures/ (with the Claude Code version) and src/hook/model-switch.ts reads its real field names; the guessed aliases go.
Proof: the hook test reads the captured fixture and writes one log line naming both models.
Files: src/hook/model-switch.ts, test/hook/, test/fixtures/
